newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria publisher settles libel action with Klestil.
newsitem.headline: Austria publisher settles libel action with Klestil.

text.p: Austrian publisher Kurt Falk has handed over 1,000,000 schillings ($92,000) to charity to settle a libel dispute with President Thomas Klestil, Austrian news agency APA reported on Monday.
In addition, Falk's tabloid daily Taeglich Alles has agreed to print a retraction of a September article that alleged Klestil was suffering from AIDS, APA said.
The Austrian president is in hospital recovering from pneumonia. His office has denied media speculation that he is suffering from AIDS or cancer.
"As far as the president is concerned the matter is closed. Taeglich Alles' grave error at least benefited people in need," presidential spokesman Heinz Nussbaumer was quoted as saying.
Klestil had planned to start legal proceedings against Taeglich Alles on Monday, APA said.
Falk's donation will go towards a home for disabled children in Graz, southern Austria. REUTER
